rules: Never use Inter, Space Grotesk, or Roboto for headings.
Use JetBrains Mono for audio metrics, timestamps, and preset tags to give a technical studio feel.
Tight letter spacing on all headings > 32px.
Strict dark mode. Do not use pure white for text; use #F4F4F5.
The Tape Amber (#E28C22) is used for CTAs to give an analog VU-meter warmth.
Each preset gets a unique color and icon on hover states.

cards.preset_card: relative overflow-hidden group cursor-pointer p-6 bento-item flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[160px]

buttons.primary: bg-[#E28C22] text-[#0A0A0C] font-bold hover:bg-[#F5A138] px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2A2A35] text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A20] px-6 py-3 rounded-md

workspace_dropzone.style: border-2 border-dashed border-[#2A2A35] bg-[#121216] hover:border-[#E28C22] transition-colors rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-center

motion.hover_effects: Preset cards should have a subtle inner glow matching their unique accent color when hovered.
motion.waveform_animation: Use dynamic CSS or Framer Motion to animate audio visualization bars.
motion.staggered_entrance: Lists and grid items should fade in with a staggered delay on mount.

images.description: High-end recording studio mixer console, used as hero overlay with bg-black/60.
Abstract colorful waveform representing processed audio.
images.placement: Mastering dashboard background or empty state visual

landing.hero: Dark overlay over studio mixer image. Huge Outfit H1 'Master Your Sound'. Tape Amber primary CTA. Include a mock waveform visualization.
landing.features_presets: Grid showing the 8 presets, each styled like a collectible card with its unique icon and hover color.
landing.testimonials: Use bento grid layout for producer quotes.
landing.pricing: Three tiers: Free ($0), Pro ($4.99/mo | $44.99/yr), Studio ($12.99/mo | $119.99/yr). Monthly/yearly toggle.

auth.layout: Split screen. Left: dark branded graphic/waveform. Right: Auth form.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (JetBrains mono links). Main area: Audio upload dropzone, recent tracks list.
dashboard.workspace: A/B waveform preview (original vs mastered). Preset picker (8 unique cards). Process & Download buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Outfit and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the 8 mastering presets in the workspace, ensuring each has its EXACT unique Lucide React icon and accent color mapped from the JSON.
Create the A/B waveform preview using custom HTML/CSS visualization (or a library like wavesurfer.js if feasible) showing before/after states.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds anywhere; use #0A0A0C for body and #121216 for cards.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, tabs, dropdowns, but override their border and background classes to match the dark slate/amber theme.
Make sure preset cards feel tactile and distinct, not generic.
Implement the Free/Pro/Studio pricing cards with Stripe checkout intent (mocked if real API not available, but UI should support it).
